narrative.northStar: The Rolling-Pin Menu Board & Folk Dish Banner
narrative.overview: Smakota's visual language translates the physical artifact of its Warsaw bistro menu, its table-tent review cards, and its 21 branded dish photographs directly into an interactive bilingual (Polish and Ukrainian) storefront. Every section is anchored by tactile culinary artifacts: the wooden rolling-pin emblem (SMAKOTA menu), pitch-espresso category stamp blocks (ZUPA, PIEROGI, PIELMIENI, CZEBUREKI, CHINKALI), deep borscht-mahogany header bars with folk three-petal flourishes, and subtle hand-drawn pierogi watermarks.
keyCharacteristics: Physical Menu Continuity: Category headers replicate the black rectangular stamp blocks with condensed paprika-terracotta display lettering from the printed menu sheet.
Borscht & Flour Warmth: Crisp menu-sheet paper (#FFFDFB) and warm dough containers (#F6EFE6, #E5D1B5) contrast with deep borscht mahogany (#5E1914) and cast-iron stamp blocks (#161110).

Honest Culinary Photography: Uses only the 21 real dish photos provided by the restaurant; dishes without separate photos use the authentic printed-menu sheet layout with category stamp badges instead of stock substitutes.
Tabular Price Precision: Every PLN (zł) price, phone number, and cart badge uses tabular-nums for instant lunchtime scanning.

rules.name: The Zero-Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary text, muted labels, and borders are always tinted from warm mahogany (#54332A, #69443A) or dough (#DEC8AE), never neutral gray.

rules.name: The Stamp Contrast Rule
rules.body: All category stamp blocks (#161110) use high-luminance paprika-orange (#F26846) to preserve the printed menu's signature look while exceeding 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings stand on their own authority or wear the black-and-terracotta stamp block directly; never place a small eyebrow label above a heading.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Declare elevation once per container: either a 1px warm border or a soft shadow, never both on the same card.

dos: Do use the black-and-terracotta stamp blocks (#161110 background, #F26846 Rubik 900 uppercase text) for all menu category headings.
Do preserve stateful bilingual switching between Polski (PL) and Українська (UA) without resetting the visitor's active branch or cart.
Do use only real client photography from img/ and transparently mark items whose prices come from online delivery profiles or await owner confirmation.
donts: Don't generate or insert stock food photography for dishes that lack an individual photo file; render those dishes in the authentic printed-menu sheet card style.
Don't place kickers or eyebrows above headings, or combine a 1px border with a wide drop shadow on the same card.
Don't enable online ordering on unconfirmed/upcoming branches (Lokal #2 — Wkrótce) or dishes marked Cena do potwierdzenia.
